sources.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
sources.snippet: Beyond the recipe itself, we provide two additional results. First, across the Puro-2B collection, we derive a Puro Cost Scaling Law that relates training cost to average model performance; the fitted law suggests that about $ 4.4K, less than $ 5,090, is sufficient to reach the performance of Qwen2-1.5B.

sources.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
sources.snippet: Puro-2B is a roughly 2B-parameter decoder-only Transformer trained from scratch on up to 1.4 trillion tokens with blockwise FP8 on consumer-grade RTX 5090 GPUs. Its architecture follows Qwen3-1.7B while untieing input embeddings from the language-model head, and the production run uses 438.8B Phase 1 tokens followed by 960.0B Phase 2 tokens.

sources.title: Puro-2B makes small-model pretraining feel operator-sized
sources.snippet: Puro-2B is not a frontier-model story. It is a recipe story: consumer GPUs, FP8 training, open data and code, and enough cost discipline to make controlled pretraining experiments plausible for smaller labs.
